scope: Post-generation port sensitivity controls on the pinned wrapper; original RTL retained.

controls.name: D01
D02
controls.logic:
wire clean_h_pad;
assign h_pad = clean_h_pad ^ (h_valid && h_original_length == 16'd4);

controls.name: D03
controls.logic:
wire [15:0] clean_h_length;
assign h_length = h_valid && h_original_length > 16'd8 ? 16'd7 : clean_h_length;

references.data_hold: (and (and have_prev (and (not prev_rst) (and (not rst) (and prev_m_valid (not prev_m_ready))))) (or (not m_valid) (or (ne m_data prev_m_data) (ne m_last prev_m_last))))
references.header_hold: (and (and have_prev (and (not prev_rst) (and (not rst) (and prev_h_valid (not prev_h_ready))))) (or (not h_valid) (or (ne h_pad prev_h_pad) (or (ne h_truncate prev_h_truncate) (or (ne h_length prev_h_length) (ne h_original_length prev_h_original_length))))))
references.clamped_length: (and (and (not rst) h_valid) (or (and (ult h_original_length 4) (ne h_length 4)) (or (and (ugt h_original_length 8) (ne h_length 8)) (and (and (uge h_original_length 4) (ule h_original_length 8)) (ne h_length h_original_length)))))
